title: Conformal Invariance of Interacting Long-Range Fermionic Models
exact_target: Prove conformal invariance of the interacting long-range fermionic renormalization-group fixed point.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005177 (OWR-11101914-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
The Renormalization Group (2022), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2022/33, pp. 1865--1925. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: Scale invariance at a fixed point does not by itself establish full conformal invariance; the source model and correlation-function conventions must be retained.
